verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven fraud-decisioning SaaS, for example batch order submission or mass status updates. However, every documented endpoint (/decide, /submit, /advise, chargeback, login) works on a single order or request, and nothing describes a batch or bulk endpoint. Automated per-order actions such as Shopify void/capture/restock are adjacent automation, not bulk operations across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
